sites.name: Huaca Pucllana
sites.what: Lima-culture adobe pyramid in Miraflores — the city on top of the older city, literally. Pre-Inca adobe so PS/HS do not apply. Night tours with lights.
look_for: Adobe pyramid massing vs modern Miraflores
sites.from_hotel: 15 min walk from Del Pilar / Kennedy Park
sites.hours: Day visits Wed–Mon ~09:00–16:00 (closed Tue); night visits historically Wed–Sun ~19:00–22:00 — confirm at hotel
sites.ticket: ~S/15 day; night tour separate; guided only

sites.name: Huaca Huallamarca
sites.what: Pre-Inca adobe huaca in San Isidro. Same “older city under the district” story as Pucllana.

sites.name: Larco Museum
sites.what: On the tour. Moche/Chimú/Nazca ceramics and gold in Pueblo Libre. Tourist bait is the erotic gallery; archive-quality is the quipu cabinet and pre-Inca metallurgy (tumbaga gilding).
look_for: Moche ceramics (not only the erotic gallery)
sites.hours: Daily 09:00–19:00 incl. holidays (official); café open later

sites.name: San Francisco church + catacombs
sites.what: On the tour. 25 000 burials; “rediscovered 1943” is a stop-shaped fact (who lost a crypt under a working church?). Cheap-check before pinning.
look_for: The 1943 rediscovery story vs the working church above

sites.name: Ollantaytambo — Temple of the Sun / Wall of the Six Monoliths
sites.what: Rose granite (not local; from Kachiqhata across the river). Lower Inca-style fieldstone vs upper megalithic course is the PC layering argument in one photo. Ruins gate 5 min from the Plaza; boleto turístico needed.
look_for: PS knobs and scoops on monolith faces
Lower fieldstone vs upper megalithic course (PC)
sites.ticket: Boleto Turístico: full S/130 (10 d) or partial Sacred Valley S/70 (2 d). Ask leader if group BTG covers it (tour buys Moray day 7)

sites.name: Piedras cansadas — tired stones
sites.what: Abandoned rose-granite megaliths on the ramp west of town toward the river. Several 20–60 t blocks in the fields. Photograph the drag faces.
look_for: Blocks in the fields toward Vilcanota
sites.from_hotel: From the Plaza down to the Vilcanota bridge, ~25 min

sites.name: Kachiqhata quarry
sites.what: Source of Ollantaytambo’s rose granite. 3–4 h round trip hike; doable day 7 afternoon if Maras/Moray return is by ~14:00. The ramp, sledge-road, and wall of stones that never left are the TS argument with your own feet on it.
look_for: Wall of stones that never left
sites.from_hotel: 3–4 h round trip hike from town
sites.hours: Daylight; 3–4 h round trip from town. Leave by 14:00 latest

sites.name: Pinkuylluna storehouses
sites.what: Opposite hillside, free, 45 min up. Best photo of the town’s Inca street grid and of the sun temple from across. The still-flowing Inca water channels in the streets are ENG in daily use.
sites.hours: Daylight only; sunset ~18:15 in March. Free, unstaffed, steep 45–60 min up

sites.name: Ñaupa Iglesia / Choquequilla
sites.what: Carved altar in a cave ~5 km toward Pachar. The “portal” niche is a standard rabbit-hole stop (acoustic-niche family). Taxi 15 min + 20 min walk; free late afternoon.
sites.from_hotel: Taxi 15 min + 20 min walk toward Pachar
sites.hours: Daylight; informal access from Pachar (~10 km, taxi S/30–40 each way), 20 min climb

sites.name: Huamanmarca
sites.what: On the tour. Usnu platform with four double-jamb doorways to the cardinal points, on the road down into the cloud forest. Inca administrative site on the Vilcabamba route. Pin candidate.
look_for: Four double doorways to the cardinal points

sites.name: Abra Málaga
sites.what: 4 316 m pass. Coffee stop, Verónica glacier view. Crossing the Cordillera Urubamba above the Vilcabamba corridor; Bingham’s 1911 route to Vitcos/Ñusta Hispana ran the other side of this range.

sites.name: Machu Picchu
sites.what: ≥3 h on site; self-guided after the group tour. Bring the questions, not the answers. ~60 % of the construction is underground drainage (ENG).
look_for: Intihuatana — flat planes, gnomon; 2000 beer-crane chip
Temple of the Sun (Torreón) + Royal Tomb cave — ashlar meets living bedrock
Temple of the Three Windows / Principal Temple — east wall subsidence
Temple of the Condor — bedrock + masonry composite
Unfinished quarry — half-split blocks with wedge-lines (Inca method on display)
sites.hours: on the tour; group tickets via portal
sites.ticket: group tickets bought ~3 months ahead — done

sites.name: Moray terraces
sites.what: Natural karst depression terraced. “Agricultural laboratory” is a hypothesis (temperature gradient ~5 °C top to bottom is measured; experimental-station story is inferred). Drainage — it never floods.
look_for: Terrace rings / temperature-gradient story as hypothesis

sites.name: Maras salt pans
sites.what: Pre-Inca. Hypersaline spring from a salt dome. One hand-cut channel feeding ~3 000 pans by gravity.

sites.name: Sacsayhuamán
sites.what: Three zigzag terraces of limestone (local). PDF says 300 t corner block — inflated; look for ~8.5 m / ~120–200 t. Killke (pre-Inca) pottery under the walls is the PC leg. Rodadero is glacially polished diorite, not melted stone.
look_for: 8.5 m corner block (not the 300 t PDF figure)
Killke pottery layer under the walls (PC)
Rodadero slide — polished rock, not melted
sites.from_hotel: On the tour, then walk; ~20–30 min from Plaza

sites.name: Quespehuara / Qhespewara huacas
sites.what: 1.5 km NW of Sacsayhuamán through eucalyptus; free; 30 min from the fortress gate. Fingerprint scoops in limestone. Photograph scoops with a scale; check whether they follow bedding planes (they do, mostly).
sites.from_hotel: 30 min walk from Sacsayhuamán gate (1.5 km NW)

sites.name: Q'enqo
sites.what: 10 min from Sacsayhuamán. Carved bedrock, zigzag channel, underground altar.
sites.ticket: Boleto Turístico (full or partial circuit I)

sites.name: Tambomachay / Puka Pukara
sites.what: Hydraulics still running. Pair with Puka Pukara on the same road out of Cusco.

sites.name: Coricancha / Qorikancha
sites.what: Finest HS jointing in the empire. Santo Domingo church on top is church-as-lid: 1650 and 1950 earthquakes threw down the church, not the Inca wall. Curved wall on Av. El Sol.
look_for: Curved wall on Av. El Sol

sites.name: Hatun Rumiyoc / 12-angled stone
sites.what: 2 min from the Plaza. Also the 14-angled stone around the corner and the “puma” in the wall on Calle Inca Roca.
look_for: Puma in the wall on Calle Inca Roca
sites.hours: Street, always (best light early morning before crowds)

sites.name: Museo Inka
sites.what: Quipus, trepanned skulls, elongated skulls — the Paracas-skull rabbit hole is here, not in Paracas.

sites.name: Museo de Arte Precolombino (MAP)
sites.what: Pre-Columbian art in Cusco. Pair with Museo Inka on a free afternoon.
sites.hours: Daily 08:00–22:00 incl. holidays (official BBVA) — the late-evening option

sites.name: Tipón
sites.what: South Valley. Best ENG site in the region — ceremonial fountains still running. Half-day with Piquillacta + Rumicolca (~35 km; taxi ~250–350 PEN — unverified).
sites.ticket: Boleto Turístico circuit II (South Valley S/70) or full

sites.name: Piquillacta
sites.what: Wari, pre-Inca planned city. PC layering on the South Valley half-day.
sites.ticket: Boleto Turístico circuit II or full

sites.name: Rumicolca
sites.what: Wari aqueduct-gate re-faced by the Inca. PC and TS in one wall. Inca quarry for Cusco’s andesite is right there.

sites.name: Chinchero
sites.what: Inca palace terraces with the church on top (church-as-lid again). Weaving co-ops. Alternative free-day option with Huchuy Qosqo.
sites.hours: Ruins + church ~07:00–18:00; market SUNDAYS only (no Sunday free in Cusco area this trip)

sites.name: Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca)
sites.what: Scenery, not archaeology. 5 200 m by ATV from 4 600 m base; 04:00 start, ~3 h each way; 158 €/178 €; min 8 pax; book ≥60 days. PDF: April–November only — confirm for March before paying.

sites.name: Raqch'i — Temple of Wiracocha
sites.what: On the tour. 92 m wall is adobe on an andesite base course — photograph the andesite lower course (HS/PS); adobe above is why it “looks unfinished”. Round qolqa storehouses (200+).
look_for: Andesite base course vs adobe above

sites.name: Pukara museum
sites.what: On the tour. Pukara culture (500 BCE–200 CE) monoliths and “decapitator” stelae — Titicaca-basin culture before Tiwanaku; the deep layer under the Puma Punku story.

sites.name: Sillustani chullpas
sites.what: Colla funerary towers ~35 km from Puno; andesite fitted-ashlar. One tower has the lizard relief. Day 10 evening or day 12 morning taxi only if the Juliaca flight is late — ask the leader first.

sites.name: Uros floating islands
sites.what: On the tour. Reed islands on Titicaca. Tourist layer is thick; still ENG (living on totora).

sites.name: Taquile
sites.what: On the tour. Collata village (~45 min), family lunch, hill walk. UNESCO textile tradition.

sites.name: Puma Punku (Tiwanaku, Bolivia)
sites.what: Across the Bolivian border (3 h from Puno + border) — not realistic on this schedule. Note as the missing piece. Andesite H-blocks with sharp inside corners.
look_for: H-blocks / inside corners — not this trip

sites.name: Apurímac source — Nevado Mismi
sites.what: Not on this tour. Documented hydrology: origin of the Apurímac (longest Amazon tributary).

sites.name: Apurímac headwaters mesas
sites.what: Not on this tour. High-puna Wari/Inca cluster; GPS region only.

sites.name: Choquequirao
sites.what: Not on this tour. Documented Inca complex above the Apurímac — “sister” of Machu Picchu. Multi-day hike.

sites.name: Q’eswachaka grass-rope bridge
sites.what: Not on this tour. Last annually rebuilt ichu-grass Inca bridge. Living practice.

sites.name: Chiaraje
sites.what: Not on this tour. Annual inter-ayllu ritual battle. GPS region (moves by year).

sites.name: Monte Sierpe — Band of Holes
sites.what: Not on this route (Pisco Valley). ~5 000+ stone-lined pits. Do not chase from Lima evening.

windows.note: Arrival. Nothing archaeological open after dark; Kennedy Park / Malecón walk only.
windows.basis: after flight; walk only · bed before midnight

windows.note: Huallamarca closes 17:00 → effectively out. Only evening play is a Pucllana night visit (historically Wed–Sun ~19–22, lit) — ask hotel to confirm + book on day 1. Larco is on the tour; its café stays open if the group finishes early.

Sunset ~18:15. Pinkuylluna storehouses climb is free, 5 min from plaza, 1 h up/down — best last-light photo of the Sun Temple terraces. Sun Temple itself closes ~17:00: only if the bus arrives before 15:30 and you have a BTG.
windows.basis: afternoon town walk ends · bed before midnight

windows.note: Quillabamba plaza/market. No sites. Pool at Purakilla.
windows.basis: Quillabamba late afternoon · bed before midnight

windows.note: 04:00 start; you will be back late. Save energy. Tired stones on the Cachiccata road are visible from the bridge in evening light if the bus passes.
windows.amount: ~6.5 h · ~1 h daylight · 04:00 start, count on 2–3 h
windows.basis: back from Tunkimayo + cacao · bed before midnight
windows.daylight: ~1 h daylight · 04:00 start, count on 2–3 h

windows.note: Train back late afternoon. Ollantaytambo old town canals + Hatun-style walls on Calle Lari at dusk. Note: Tuesday — irrelevant here but Pucllana (Lima) is closed Tuesdays.
windows.basis: train back late afternoon · bed before midnight

windows.note: THE Sacred Valley window. If back by 14:00: Kachiqhata quarry round trip (3–4 h, tired stones + ramp, back before 18:15 sunset). If back later: taxi to Pachar for Ñaupa Iglesia (1.5–2 h total). Both free, daylight only, no ticket.
windows.basis: Maras + Moray + lunch · bed before midnight

windows.note: Coricancha until 17:30 (separate S/15–20 ticket) → Hatun Rumiyoc 12-angle stone on the walk → MAP museum is open until 22:00, so it is the after-dinner slot. Museo Inka closes 16:00 — only if Sacsayhuamán tour ends before 14:30. Planetarium 18:00 pick-up (S/75) competes with MAP.

Full day. Option A South Valley: Tipón (water channels) → Piquillacta (Wari grid) → Rumicolca gate; taxi day ~S/150–200, BTG circuit II S/70. Option B Chinchero + Huchuy Qosqo — but NO Sunday market on a Friday, so A wins unless you want the walk. Museo Inka Fri 09–16 fits the morning if you stay in town. Rainbow Mountain: PDF says Apr–Nov only — March is rainy season; treat as unavailable unless Albatros confirms.
windows.basis: full free day · bed before midnight

windows.note: Longest drive; Puno arrival at dusk. Sillustani (30 km) not realistic. Dreyer museum near plaza (S/15) if it is still open on arrival — unverified hours.
windows.basis: Puno at dusk · bed before midnight

windows.note: Back from Taquile late afternoon. Sunday: museums closed. Plaza + cathedral exterior.
windows.basis: back from Taquile · bed before midnight

windows.window: morning (only if Juliaca flight is afternoon)
windows.note: Sillustani opens ~08:00, S/15, 45 min each way from Puno, on the way to Juliaca airport. Ask the tour leader the flight time on day 10; if departure is after 13:00 a 3 h detour works with a private taxi (~S/120).
windows.basis: ask leader day 10 · bed before midnight
